question: In which city was the final match of the 2015 Indian Super League season held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Goa**__.

**__Key Points__**

__

• The final match of the **2015 Indian Super League (ISL)** season was held at the **Fatorda Stadium**, officially known as the **Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium**, located in **Margao, Goa**.

• The match took place on **20 December 2015**, featuring a high-stakes encounter between **Chennaiyin FC** and the home side, **FC Goa**.

• **Chennaiyin FC** secured their first-ever **ISL title** by defeating **FC Goa** with a scoreline of 3-2 in one of the most dramatic finishes in the league's history.

• Colombian striker **Stiven Mendoza** was the star performer for **Chennaiyin FC**, scoring the decisive goal in the 90th minute and finishing the season with the **Golden Boot** award.

• The **2015 season** was the **second edition** of the tournament, which has since grown to become the premier top-tier professional football league in India.

 **Additional Information__**

• **Mumbai**:

• The city hosted the inaugural **ISL final in 2014** at the **DY Patil Stadium** in **Navi Mumbai**, where **Atletico de Kolkata** defeated **Kerala Blasters FC** to become the first champions.

• **Kochi**:

• The **Jawaharlal Nehru International Stadium** in **Kochi**, known for its massive fan attendance, served as the venue for the **2016 ISL final**.

• **Kolkata**:

• Regarded as the **football capital of India**, it is home to legendary clubs like **Mohun Bagan** and **East Bengal**, and its **Salt Lake Stadium** hosted the first match in the history of the **Indian Super League**.
